legacy.body:
## Summary

Define the three ETL stages and the data contract between them.

## Context

The library is used by dashboards, but the stage interfaces and error model are
not specified.

## Expected outcome

- `Extractor`, `Transformer`, and `Loader` protocols.
- Typed records between stages.
- Error and partial-failure behavior.
- A fixture-driven test harness.
- A versioned public API.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each stage has a documented interface.
- [ ] Records are typed.
- [ ] Partial failure is explicit.
- [ ] A fixture can run through all three stages.
- [ ] Breaking changes follow semver.

## References

- Boundaries: ops/templates#31
- Shared contracts: ops/templates#32
- Publish: #8
